parsed.name: INHECO 温控控制盒
parsed.description: 一款用于实验室温度控制模块的热电温控控制盒，可为加热/制冷附件提供控制与状态交互，常用于样品、板位或实验流程中的温度管理。
parsed.description_en: A thermoelectric temperature control box for laboratory temperature-control modules. It provides control and device interaction for heating/cooling accessories, and is commonly used for managing sample, plate, or workflow temperatures.

actions.description: 初始化并建立与温控控制盒的通信。
actions.description_en: Initialize the device and establish communication with the temperature control box.

actions.description: 停止温控控制盒的当前运行。
actions.description_en: Stop the current operation of the temperature control box.

actions.description: 向温控控制盒发送底层命令并读取返回结果。
actions.description_en: Send a low-level command to the temperature control box and read back the response.

actions.description: 启用或禁用控制盒触摸屏。
actions.description_en: Enable or disable the control box touchscreen.

actions.description: 重置控制盒的动作显示界面。
actions.description_en: Reset the action display on the control box.
